repos.name: twilio/twilio-node
repos.why: Largest qualifying npm repo with TypeScript 5.9: 777 TS files, mostly generated API types. Plain tsc 13 s on a GitHub Linux runner (4.4 s on an M4 Mac). Jest suite passes in about 40 s in CI.

repos.name: cheeriojs/cheerio
repos.why: Well-known library with a public API and clear docs. Plain tsc 2.2 s warm. Vitest passes in about 7 s; `npm test` also runs lint, which fails at this commit.

repos.name: nteract/semiotic
repos.why: Large TypeScript 6.0.3 library: 2,793 TS files, plain tsc about 18 s on a GitHub Linux runner. Ships its own AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md that tell agents to run `npm run typescript`. Its vitest suite takes over 3 minutes, so success is checked with tsc and the task checks only.
